name: Can I remain living in my home during a kitchen remodel?

mainEntity.name: Can I remain living in my home during a kitchen remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Living in your home is feasible during construction, but you will lose access to your primary cooking area, sink, and dishwasher for several weeks. Homeowners who stay typically set up a temporary kitchenette in another room using a microwave, hot plate, mini-fridge, and access to a secondary sink. You will need to manage dust, noise, and regular trade traffic during working hours. Setting up your secondary prep area and packing away non-essential kitchenware beforehand keeps daily routines manageable.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, but you will need a temporary kitchenette elsewhere in the house. Preparing for dust, noise, and temporary loss of running water in the kitchen is essential.
